invariants.rationale: It is common for setter methods to expect non-null input, as null polygons might not be meaningful.
Usually, a Polygon's vertices array should exist; meaningful polygon objects typically have an associated array.
Polygons are defined by pairs of coordinates, so the array length is likely even.
A polygon with less than six coordinates would not form a valid polygon (at least 3 points, thus 6 numbers).
It is typical for the transformed vertices to exist for valid transformations and rendering of polygons.
